result.instructions: Tools for Jubelio, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which products have the lowest stock, and in which locations?"; "Show the cancelled sales orders and their cancel reasons."; "Find the product with SKU ABC-123 and show its stock by location.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Jubelio data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run jubelio_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run jubelio_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run jubelio_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. jubelio_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: jubelio_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products (items) with their code, name, category, prices and status. Filter with a free-text query. Jubelio API: GET /inventory/items/.

q.description: Free-text filter, for example a name, code or number.

sort_by.description: Field to sort by, as Jubelio names it in its list replies.

tools.name: jubelio_save_contact
tools.title: Create or edit a contact
tools.description: Create a customer, vendor or both (contact_id 0, the default), or edit one (its contact_id). This writes to the Jubelio account. An edit may clear fields you leave out, so read the contact with jubelio_get_contact first. Jubelio API: POST /contacts/.

contact_id.description: 0 (default) creates a contact. An existing contact id edits that contact.

is_company.description: True if the contact is a company.

primary_contact.description: Name of the primary person at the contact.
